rule: No provider is assumed to understand BodyGenerationConditioning natively. Brickmen adapters must translate conditioning into provider-native inputs and then post-align/repair outputs while preserving mechanical authority boundaries.

providers.name: PartCrafter
hardware_notes: Local GPU inference; upstream repository downloads model weights automatically in its quick-start path.

pre_generation: choose source/reference render or Brickmen-conditioned guide render
set part-count hint from required generated component slots
optionally generate masks/labels from component slots for downstream mapping
post_generation: map returned parts to Brickmen component slots
align part frames to skeleton landmarks
trim generated geometry away from fixed-mm mechanical keep-outs
insert deterministic validated interfaces only after visual-shell cleanup

limitations: Does not natively consume Brickmen skeleton/envelope/keep-out JSON.
Part identity/order must be verified after generation.
Generated mating geometry has no manufacturing authority.

execution.upstream_requirement_note: Official README states CUDA GPU with at least 8GB VRAM; reduce parts/tokens to lower memory.

upstream_verification.verification_scope: Brickmen execution interface and output contract only; not model quality or production authority

providers.name: PartPacker
hardware_notes: Upstream documents PyTorch/CUDA local inference and tested RTX 3090/4090 configurations.
Upstream can use multiple GPUs but falls back to one GPU.

pre_generation: retain Brickmen component-slot graph separately for output matching
post_generation: segment/map generated part meshes to expected slots
align to skeleton/envelope controls
repair interpenetration and shell boundaries
subtract keep-outs and insert validated interfaces

limitations: Current Brickmen research has not verified a native exact part-count control.
Provider part decomposition may not match Brickmen manufacturing component boundaries.
Generated interfaces are visual hypotheses only.

execution.upstream_requirement_note: Official README states ~10GB GPU memory for inference assuming float16.

upstream_verification.verification_scope: Brickmen execution interface and output contract only; not model quality or production authority

providers.name: PAct

pre_generation: supply or review a 2D component/part label mask; PAct custom inference is not image-only
retain Brickmen expected component slots and selected skeleton as external truth constraints
post_generation: compare generated part graph with expected Brickmen component graph
compare inferred articulation axes/ranges with Brickmen skeleton/joint profiles
discard or override learned fit-critical geometry
use generated surfaces only after deterministic interface insertion

limitations: Learned articulation is evidence/candidate structure, not production mechanical authority.
Brickmen must retain control of component count, hardware, tolerances and validated joint geometry.
Current upstream custom Gradio workflow requires image plus a 2D part mask.
Current upstream infer_imgs.py parses --data_dir but hardcodes assets/real_world_examples when constructing ImageConditioned_dataset.
Arbitrary-input execution requires an upstream-compatible semantic part-label EXR mask; Brickmen does not invent label semantics.
Lossless PNG/TIFF convenience input must encode background 0 and contiguous positive part labels 1..N; multicolor visualization masks are rejected.

execution.upstream_requirement_note: Brickmen wrapper redirects PAct's hardcoded ImageConditioned_dataset root in-process without modifying the upstream checkout. Supply a PAct-compatible semantic part-label EXR or a lossless integer-label PNG/TIFF; raster labels are redirected only for the staged mask read.

upstream_verification.verification_scope: Brickmen execution interface and output contract only; not model quality or production authority

providers.name: Particulate

post_generation: run on generated visual mesh candidate
compare inferred components/joints to Brickmen expected component slots and skeleton
flag topology or motion disagreements
never overwrite validated Brickmen mechanical records automatically

limitations: Not a primary geometry generator.
Articulation predictions require reconciliation with deterministic Brickmen engineering evidence.

upstream_verification.verification_scope: Brickmen execution interface and output contract only; not model quality or production authority

providers.name: SAM 3D Objects
hardware_notes: Upstream default setup documents Linux x86-64 and an NVIDIA GPU with at least 32 GB VRAM.

pre_generation: supply binary mask for the target object/component
post_generation: record Gaussian reconstruction, pose and scale as visual evidence
do not feed public quick-start PLY directly into triangle-mesh manufacturing validation
evaluate internal mesh postprocessing only as a separate researched adapter if its public/support boundary is verified

limitations: Public quick-start output is a Gaussian splat/point-cloud PLY, not a validated printable triangle mesh.
Binary object mask is required for the published API path.
Internal mesh postprocessing should not be assumed stable/public without separate verification.

execution.upstream_requirement_note: Brickmen wrapper calls the published notebook.inference Inference/load_image/load_mask API and exports output['gs'] to PLY. This is a visual Gaussian baseline and does not enter triangle-mesh production validation.

upstream_verification.verification_scope: Brickmen execution interface and output contract only; not model quality or production authority

providers.name: UniPart

pre_generation: single RGB image according to the published image-guided method
post_generation: map generated independent part meshes to Brickmen component slots
reconcile part decomposition with Brickmen skeleton and architecture
retain Brickmen deterministic mechanical authority

limitations: Official CVPR 2026 project page and paper are verified, but no public code/model link was found on the project page or author publication page as of 2026-09-27.
Published method is highly relevant to Brickmen because it outputs decomposable full-resolution part meshes, but no runnable Brickmen adapter can be verified without an implementation.
Published training uses substantial GPU resources; inference hardware requirements cannot be inferred safely from the paper alone.

research_status.revisit_trigger: official code, weights, demo, or repository release

providers.name: PWM-ArtGen
hardware_notes: Official setup pins Python 3.10, PyTorch 2.2.2 and CUDA 11.8 packages.
Single-image preprocessing may use a separate SAM/SAM3 environment.
No official minimum inference VRAM was verified in the repository documentation reviewed on 2026-09-27.

pre_generation: part graph prediction from API or cached graph JSON
category from the seven supported appliance/furniture categories
post_generation: normalize geom_pred.json into Brickmen articulation evidence
compare predicted axes/ranges/AABBs with Brickmen skeleton without overwriting it
treat retrieved meshes as category-library exemplars rather than free-form Brickmen shell geometry
do not use PWM retrieval output as production component geometry for unsupported humanoid/character bodies

limitations: Official single-image demo currently supports only StorageFurniture, Table, Refrigerator, Oven, Microwave, WashingMachine, and Dishwasher; Brickmen humanoid/character bodies are outside the documented domain.
Final meshes are assembled through retrieval from a PartNet-Mobility-derived database rather than unrestricted free-form part mesh generation.
Single-image preprocessing can call a configured graph-prediction API and may incur charges unless cached graph JSON is supplied.
Project/model card did not specify a project license in the reviewed 2026-09-27 repository snapshot; external models and datasets retain separate terms.
Because Brickmen body figures are outside the documented categories, this provider is not a verified primary Brickmen generator despite the now-runnable upstream pipeline.

execution.upstream_requirement_note: Official single-image demo is runnable but category-limited and retrieval-backed; Brickmen intentionally does not mark it as a verified body-generator adapter.

upstream_verification.verification_scope: Upstream single-image stages, geom_pred articulation output, retrieval-backed mesh output and documented supported categories.

providers.name: SAM3D-Part
hardware_notes: Upstream README reference environment: Python 3.11, PyTorch 2.6.0+cu124.
Upstream README reference hardware: one 80 GB H100/A100-class GPU.
Installation builds several CUDA extensions and expects a matching CUDA toolkit/nvcc.

pre_generation: validated or candidate generated Brickmen body mesh
reviewed target component or local region
post_generation: treat regenerated part as a replacement candidate for exactly one Brickmen component slot
reconcile output back to Brickmen-mm frame and preserve provider provenance
rerun mesh quality, envelope, fixed keepout and articulation collision gates
never transfer mechanical-interface authority from the replaced component automatically

limitations: Current official entry point is an interactive Gradio app rather than a stable headless Brickmen API.
Reference environment uses an 80 GB H100/A100-class GPU and a heavy CUDA-extension stack.
Part selection depends on a rendered view and click/mask interaction; Brickmen still needs a deterministic headless prompt/region adapter.
The stage-1 model derives from SAM 3D Objects and carries SAM Agreement obligations; vendored TRELLIS/TRELLIS.2 and Hunyuan3D components have separate terms.
This is a post-generation part repair/refinement candidate, not a verified initial Brickmen body generator.

execution.upstream_requirement_note: Official app is runnable; Brickmen has not yet verified a stable headless callable that bypasses global model initialization/Gradio while preserving all required render-mask-pointmap inputs.

upstream_verification.verification_scope: Interactive mesh upload/render/click/part generation flow, output role, reference environment and licensing notes.
